title: ‘Won’t take orders anymore’: Why Bengaluru restaurants are threatening to boycott Zomato, Swiggy
description: Bengaluru restaurants are poised to boycott food delivery platforms like Swiggy and Zomato from August 15. The Bruhat Bengaluru Hotels Association (BBHA) has voiced strong opposition to the platforms' fee structures, which they argue erode restaurant profits through high commissions (8-28%), unapproved discounts, and unclear payout deductions. Restaurants are demanding a written response that includes a detailed breakdown of charges, fairer policies for order cancellations and customer complaints, and improved communication.
content:

title: Eternal Limited FY26 Annual Report: Consolidated Revenue Surges 169% YoY to INR 54,364 Crore
description: Eternal Limited (formerly Zomato Limited) reported a transformative FY26 with consolidated revenue surging 169% YoY to INR 54,364 crore, driven by a shift to the inventory-led quick commerce model. Consolidated PAT declined to INR 366 crore from INR 527 crore, while Adjusted EBITDA improved to INR 1,189 crore. Key leadership changes included Albinder Singh Dhindsa becoming CEO and Deepinder Goyal transitioning to Vice Chairman. The 16th AGM is scheduled for August 26, 2026.
